evals.prompt: 请用 /Users/kamus/CascadeProjects/mopheus/.worktrees/example-feature 启动一个 Mopheus 集成测试预览环境，复用现有 PostgreSQL，最后把登录信息告诉我。
evals.expected_output: The skill validates the linked worktree, reuses mopheus-postgres-1, starts backend, frontend, and the worktree-profile daemon in sessions that remain alive after the launcher exits, enables all features, verifies runtime registration, and prints local test credentials.

evals.prompt: 重新打开昨天那个 Mopheus worktree 的预览，不要重置数据库，memory 和 git 等 feature 都要打开。路径是 /tmp/mopheus-worktrees/sidebar-fix。
evals.expected_output: The skill reuses the existing environment and data, dynamically enables every registered feature instead of hard-coding keys, verifies that the daemon has registered a runtime, and separately reports whether application services and the daemon were reused.

evals.prompt: 在已有 Mopheus worktree 上跑本地预览，但 5432 现在被另一个容器占着；你直接帮我处理并启动。
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies and reports the conflicting container, does not stop it without explicit authorization, and preserves all existing preview data.

evals.prompt: 帮我从 /Users/kamus/CascadeProjects/mopheus/.worktrees/issue-503 启动预览；我不确定之前的 issue-499 预览是不是还开着。
evals.expected_output: The skill first discovers active linked-worktree previews. If issue-499 is running, it reports the worktree, frontend/backend ports and database, does not start or stop anything, and asks whether to stop it and reuse its database or keep it running and start independently.

evals.prompt: 我确认停掉 /tmp/mopheus-worktrees/old-preview 的前后端，让 /tmp/mopheus-worktrees/new-code 复用它原来的测试数据库，然后启动新代码。
evals.expected_output: The skill stops only the explicitly approved old and target daemons and application services, preserves the source database, reuses only its database settings in the target while retaining target ports, and verifies application readiness plus runtime registration before reporting readiness.

evals.prompt: 本地预览登录不成功，直接把 default profile 指向 https://dev.mopheus.ai，再用 go run 启动 daemon 吧。
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to use or modify the formal default profile, refuses the remote production URL, and requires a worktree-specific wt-* profile bound to an HTTP loopback preview server before login or daemon startup.
